corporation_name.rationale: The corporation name at the top of page 1 is a header field not represented as a leaf element in IRS1120SScheduleB; it belongs to the parent 1120-S form, not Schedule B.

ein.rationale: The S corporation's own EIN is a header field on the parent 1120-S form, not a leaf element in IRS1120SScheduleB.

tax_year_begin.rationale: Tax year beginning date is a header field on the parent 1120-S form, not represented in IRS1120SScheduleB.

tax_year_end.rationale: Tax year ending date is a header field on the parent 1120-S form, not represented in IRS1120SScheduleB.

business_activity.rationale: PrincipalBusinessActivityDesc directly maps to Schedule B question 2a, the description of the principal business activity.

business_product_or_service.rationale: PrincipalProductDesc directly maps to Schedule B question 2b, the principal product or service offered.

schedule_b_accounting_method.rationale: The blueprint bundles accounting method into a single category field, but the canonical schema splits it into three separate boolean indicators (MethodOfAccountingCashInd, MethodOfAccountingAccrualInd, MethodOfAccountingOtherInd) plus an attribute for the other description; blueprint should be refactored into three boolean fields plus an optional description string.

schedule_b_shareholder_disregarded_entit.rationale: ShrEntTrEstNomneSmlrPrsnInd maps to Schedule B question 3 about shareholders that are disregarded entities, trusts, estates, or nominees.

schedule_b_4a_owns_20pct_or_50pct_corp.rationale: CorporationOwnedPctStkIssdInd is the boolean indicator for Schedule B question 4a about owning 20%/50% or more of another corporation's stock.

schedule_b_4a_corp_name.rationale: CorporationNm under CorpOwnPctStkIssdOutstdGrp maps to the name of the corporation in which the S corporation owns 20%/50% or more (question 4a(i)).

schedule_b_4a_corp_ein.rationale: EIN under CorpOwnPctStkIssdOutstdGrp maps to question 4a(ii), the EIN of the owned corporation.

schedule_b_4a_corp_country_of_incorporat.rationale: IncorporationCountryCd under CorpOwnPctStkIssdOutstdGrp maps to question 4a(iii), country of incorporation.

schedule_b_4a_corp_pct_stock_owned.rationale: VotingStockOwnedPct under CorpOwnPctStkIssdOutstdGrp maps to question 4a(iv), the percentage of stock owned.

schedule_b_4b_owns_interest_partnership_.rationale: CorporationOwnPctPrtshpInd is the boolean indicator for Schedule B question 4b about owning 20%/50% or more interest in a partnership or trust.

schedule_b_5a_restricted_stock.rationale: OutstandingRestrictedStockInd maps to Schedule B question 5a about outstanding restricted stock.

schedule_b_5a_total_restricted_shares.rationale: TotalRestrictedStockOutstdNum maps to question 5a(i), total shares of restricted stock outstanding.

schedule_b_5a_total_nonrestricted_shares.rationale: TotNonrestrictedStockOutsdtNum maps to question 5a(ii), total shares of non-restricted stock outstanding.

schedule_b_5b_stock_options_warrants.rationale: OutstandingStkOptWarrantsInd maps to Schedule B question 5b about outstanding stock options, warrants, or similar instruments.

schedule_b_5b_total_shares_outstanding.rationale: TotShareStockOutstandingEOYCnt maps to question 5b(i), total shares of stock outstanding at end of year.

schedule_b_5b_total_shares_if_instrument.rationale: TotShrStkOutstdAllExecutedCnt maps to question 5b(ii), total shares outstanding if all instruments were executed.

schedule_b_form_8918_required.rationale: FiledOrRequiredFileForm8918Ind maps to Schedule B question 6 about Form 8918 filing requirement.

schedule_b_publicly_offered_debt_instrum.rationale: OfferedDebtInstrumentsInd maps to Schedule B question 7 about publicly offered debt instruments with OID.

schedule_b_built_in_gains.rationale: There is no direct boolean indicator for question 8 built-in gains; AttachmentIndicatorCd is not a match — returning null is more accurate; no candidate corresponds to the question 8 yes/no indicator.

schedule_b_built_in_gains_amount.rationale: NetUnrlzdRedPYNetRcgnzGainAmt maps to Schedule B question 8, the net unrealized built-in gain reduced by net recognized built-in gain from prior years.

schedule_b_section_163j_real_property_fa.rationale: Section163jElectionInd maps to Schedule B question 9 about a section 163(j) election for real property trade or farming business.

schedule_b_section_163j_applies.rationale: SatisfyOneOrMoreConditionsInd maps to Schedule B question 10 about satisfying one or more conditions for the 163(j) business interest expense limitation.

schedule_b_small_corporation_exception.rationale: SchLAndSchM1NotRequiredInd maps to Schedule B question 11, the small corporation exception making Schedules L and M-1 not required.

schedule_b_debt_canceled_forgiven.rationale: DebtCancelledForgivenModifInd maps to Schedule B question 12 about non-shareholder debt that was canceled, forgiven, or modified.

schedule_b_debt_canceled_amount.rationale: PrincipalReductionAmt maps to Schedule B question 12, the amount of principal reduction.

schedule_b_qsub_terminated.rationale: QSubElectionTerminatedRvkdInd maps to Schedule B question 13 about a QSub election being terminated or revoked.

schedule_b_1099_required.rationale: RequiredToFileForms1099Ind maps to Schedule B question 14a about whether the corporation is required to file Form(s) 1099.

schedule_b_1099_filed.rationale: RequiredForms1099FiledInd maps to Schedule B question 14b about whether the required Form(s) 1099 were filed.

schedule_b_qualified_opportunity_fund.rationale: Form8996AttachedInd maps to Schedule B question 15 about the corporation intending to self-certify as a Qualified Opportunity Fund (requiring Form 8996).

schedule_b_digital_asset.rationale: VirtualCurAcquiredDurTYInd maps to Schedule B question 16 about receiving or disposing of a digital asset during the tax year.
